# Captured CLI output must stay suitable for scripts and editors.
go build -o app$GOEXE .
! stdout .
! stderr .

# Cached builds must stay quiet too.
go build -o app$GOEXE .
! stdout .
! stderr .

env GOBIN=$WORK/bin
go install .
! stdout .
! stderr .

go build -json -o app$GOEXE .
! stdout .
! stderr .

go list -export -f '{{.ImportPath}}' .
stdout '^example.com/progress$'
! stderr .

# The Windows terminal implementation must not pull net into go_bootstrap.
env GOOS=windows
env GOARCH=amd64
go list -tags=cmd_go_bootstrap -deps cmd/go
! stdout '^net$'
! stdout '^os/user$'
! stdout '^crypto/x509$'
! stdout '^cmd/vendor/golang.org/x/term$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/progress

go 1.26
-- main.go --
package main

func main() {}
